summary: Bluejoint Mountain lookout at the edge of Granby Provincial Park, BC: a 2025 trip report found it inactive on the summit; no build, staffing or access-rule record was found.

facts.status_note: A 2026 guide lists it among lookouts confirmed or likely to have standing structures; a July 2025 trip report describes it on the summit as inactive.

visit.trail_note: Rough access road with numerous water bars; the trip report advises high clearance and AWD or 4WD. A trail runs up the south ridge to the summit.

events.note: Trip report from July 2025 describes the fire lookout on the summit as inactive, with a helipad on the broad summit.
Rainlander guide lists the Bluejoint Mtn Fire Lookout (Granby Provincial Park) among BC lookouts confirmed or likely to have standing structures.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Canada Lookouts gives 2363 m (7,753 ft) for the Bluejoint entry; the July 2025 trip report caption gives the summit as 2320 metres. The story gives both figures and attributes each to its source.

notes_for_editor: Brief's kind 'two_story' is not confirmed by any fetched page, so it is not recorded. No build date, staffing record, or managing agency was found; the agency is left out of facts. Access rules are unknown and no source says whether the public may visit; the trip report describes the lookout's interior, which is not used. Facebook search snippet (BC Forest Fire Lookouts group, 'Bluejoint Mountain Lookout', 2025) mentions a steel tower erected in 1917 and an observer's cabin built in 197x at a 'Blue Mountain Fire Observation Station'; the page could not be read and it is not used.
